basic_info.description: 3BR/2.5BA Glen Park home w/ a fantastic yard & view roof deck * Large scale living room w/ a wood burning fireplace, recessed lighting & 2 south-west facing bay windows (each w/ a window seat) that let in tremendous natural light * Wonderful kitchen w/ partial butcher block counters & stainless steel appliances including a 5-burner gas range * Dining area w/ built in seating * Direct access to the beautifully landscaped yard. An $80K hardscape and landscape project in 2021 resulted in a tiered yard with multiple outdoor rooms suitable for entertaining, dining & simply relaxing * A half bath completes the first level * The 2nd floor bedroom level has the highly sought after 3BR/2BA all on one floor layout * The primary suite offers serene garden views & an en-suite bath, creating a peaceful retreat * Thesizabletop floor room w/ fireplace can be used for multiple purposes. Take advantage of the pre-set plumbing behind the wall in the closet to add a wet bar or another bath * Direct access to a roof deck with southern hill and bay views is perfect for indoor/outdoor living. * Refinished hardwood and bamboo flooring * Double paned windows throughout the front facade * Fantastic Glen Park location, walk to the shops & restaurants inGlen Park Village. Close to Bart & freeway access
